display.title: Feather Fletching

lines: Good. Half-finished arrows are patient, if nothing else.
Put Feather Fletching aside for now?

abandoned_forever: Then the feather request is closed for good.

lines: Then keep the feathers dry until you are ready.
Feather Fletching is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

inactive: The fletching bench is not accepting feathers right now.

unavailable: This feather request is not ready to close yet.

lines: Then the arrows remain half-dressed and opinionated.
I have shafts waiting on one side and patience failing on the other.
A bundle of feathers would fix both problems.

inactive: The bench has no active feather count at the moment.

lines: If you have the feathers, we can settle Feather Fletching.
Keep the feathers together until the bench can use them.
